bullets_zh: BrainFlow 是面向非侵入式 EEG 与 BCI 开发板的开源库。
文档列出 OpenBCI Cyton、Ganglion、Galea 及合成或流式板等支持硬件。
它帮助开发者采集、流式传输和处理消费级 EEG 数据。
bullets_en: BrainFlow is an open-source library for non-invasive EEG and BCI boards.
The docs list supported hardware such as OpenBCI Cyton, Ganglion, Galea, and synthetic or streaming boards.
It helps developers acquire, stream, and process consumer EEG data.

items.title_en: Unicorn Hybrid Black: EEG Headset & Brain-Computer Interface Platform for Real-Time EEG
bullets_zh: g.tec Unicorn Hybrid Black是可穿戴EEG头带与BCI平台，用于实时脑信号采集。
它支持科研、教育和消费级非侵入式BCI流程，无需手术。
产品页说明硬件特性与软件生态，便于入门使用。
bullets_en: g.tec Unicorn Hybrid Black is a wearable EEG headset and BCI platform for real-time brain signal acquisition.
It supports research, education and consumer-style non-invasive BCI workflows without surgery.
The product page documents hardware features and software ecosystem for getting started.
